title: Pay now, terms later: conflicts retained
shortTitle: Pay now, terms later: conflicts retained
summary: Hill and Klocek address the same broad pattern through different formation accounts.
notes: Compare review opportunities, prior warning, the role of return costs, initial payment, ongoing obligations, offeror identity, and the applicability of § 2-207 to an oral order followed by one writing. The notes question the implications of delaying all formation, preserve Brower and Howard as dated reports, and ask whether wholly online transactions change the practical case for postponing terms. No harmonized universal rule is supplied.
